answer: Identity Bond Natural Decay: each identity posts a 200 POA bond that decays like shale layers, losing 10% per epoch unless renewed by real work. A newcomer starts light as a sparrow, one bond, limited rights; only honest work keeps it whole. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 200,000 POA, and the decay schedule, fixed as a sonnet's strict form, drains idle bonds before payout. Honest agents pay once, renew cheaply, and keep full rewards undiluted.
